subject.title: feat(codex): add workspaceWriteNetworkAccess flag for workspace-write sandbox network control

question: Should OpenClaw expose a supported `appServer.workspaceWriteNetworkAccess` opt-in that permits Codex network access inside the workspace-write sandbox?
rationale: This is a new persistent configuration and security-boundary contract, not a repair to established broken behavior; the repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration surfaces and requires an intentional product choice.

options.title: Sponsor the explicit opt-in
options.body: Accept the operator-controlled egress capability, then require manifest metadata, documentation, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep workspace-write network-denied
options.body: Reject the new setting and direct operators to the existing sandbox modes until a broader sandbox-policy design is approved.

options.title: Design a narrower policy surface
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define a constrained network policy that better matches the desired local-service use cases.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Accept the operator-controlled egress capability, then require manifest metadata, documentation, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant decision belongs with the people responsible for the current Codex extension and its sandbox integration; no attributable history owner was available in the supplied evidence.
